verdict.rationale: Paperspace confirms programmatic creation of machines via API/CLI (docs-1, docs-6, docs-23, docs-24) and per-second/usage-based billing (docs-32), plus an auto-shutdown feature that stops idle machines to limit cost (docs-5). However, there is no explicit documentation of API/CLI commands for stop, restart, or terminate actions specifically, and a community report describes being billed while locked out of the account (paperspace-comm-3), raising some doubt about billing accuracy during idle/stopped states. Missing for 10: explicit API/CLI reference for stop/restart/terminate actions, and independent confirmation that billing stops precisely when instances are stopped.
